text: 上策：肉身出去
en: Best strategy: physically go abroad.

text: 中策：梯子只看英文报道
en: Middle strategy: use a VPN to read only English reports.

text: 下策：财新开个会员
en: Worst strategy: get a Caixin membership.

text: 无需避免，做好选择就行——选择适合自己的信息茧房。
en: No need to avoid it; just make good choices — choose an information cocoon that suits you.

text: 你以为移动互联网时代，少玩手机就能避免信息茧房了？
en: Do you think that in the mobile internet era, playing less with your phone can help you avoid information cocoons?

text: 能不能避免信息茧房我不知道，但是不看手机你绝对会脱离社会，脱离时代，甚至错过很多赚钱的机会。
en: I don't know whether you can avoid information cocoons, but if you don't look at your phone, you will definitely detach from society, detach from the times, and even miss many money-making opportunities.

text: 放心，我不是来给你推荐赚钱项目的，也不是来割韭菜收学费的。
en: Rest assured, I'm not here to recommend money-making projects to you, nor to harvest leeks and charge tuition.

text: 我来讲一下我对信息茧房的两点看法：
en: Let me talk about my two views on information cocoons:

text: 1、人是环境的产物，每个人都有自己的信息茧房
en: 1. People are products of their environment; everyone has their own information cocoon.

text: 很多人总是把信息茧房狭隘的理解成各种互联网平台尤其是短视频的算法推荐机制，这是狭隘的。
en: Many people always narrowly understand information cocoons as the algorithm recommendation mechanisms of various internet platforms, especially short videos. This is narrow.

text: 更有奇葩说什么放下手机，把省下来的时间看书就不会陷入信息茧房了。
en: Even stranger are those who say that putting down your phone and spending the saved time reading books will keep you from falling into information cocoons.

text: P嘞~
en: Pfft~

text: 你每天抱着金庸武侠小说看，看着看着都觉得自己学会降龙十八掌就能独步武林，天下无敌了，这是不是信息茧房？
en: If you hold Jin Yong martial arts novels every day, reading until you feel that learning the Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms will let you roam the martial world unrivalled and invincible under heaven — is this not an information cocoon?

text: 你每天抱着言情小说，诗词歌赋看的自己四体不勤五谷不分、不食人间烟火，整天活在空气中，就不叫信息茧房了？
en: If you hold romance novels, poetry and songs every day, reading until your limbs are idle, grains undistinguished, detached from worldly life, living in thin air all day — is that not called an information cocoon?

text: 人生而自由，却无往不在枷锁之中。
en: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.

text: 你以为自己从手机这个火坑解脱出来了，殊不知又跳进了另一个火坑。
en: You think you have escaped from the fire pit of the phone, little knowing you have jumped into another fire pit.

text: 脱离手机就万事大吉了？
en: Does leaving your phone mean everything is fine?

text: 不仅不会让你获得自由，在这个信息爆炸的时代，你反而很容易就被时代的洪流抛弃。
en: Not only will it not give you freedom, but in this era of information explosion, you will instead easily be abandoned by the torrent of the times.

text: 两个星期不看手机，你甚至参加朋友聚会的时候，你自己都不知道他们在聊什么。
en: If you don't look at your phone for two weeks, you won't even know what they are talking about when you attend a friends' gathering.

text: 还想着过着复古的生活，最后只能接受社会的毒打，让自己的贫穷为自己的生活买单。
en: Still dreaming of living a retro life, you can only end up accepting society's harsh beatings, letting your poverty pay for your life.

text: 看到网红带货一个晚上销售2个亿，你说自己从来不看网红，也不在直播间买东西。
en: Seeing an influencer sell 200 million yuan in one night of livestreaming, you say you never watch influencers and never buy things in livestreams.

text: 不仅不觉得自己脱离了时代，脱离了社会，还在那里沾沾自喜，觉得自己与众不同，充满高级感。
en: Not only do you not feel detached from the times and society, you are there feeling smug, thinking you are different, full of superiority.

text: 然后说人家直播间都是注水造假的，根本不赚钱。
en: Then you say their livestream rooms are all inflated and fake, and don't make money at all.

text: 直到看到薇娅被罚13.14个亿，你破防了，你不理解了。
en: Until you see Viya fined 1.314 billion yuan, your defences break, and you don't understand.

text: 为什么有的人高学历辛辛苦苦工作一个月挣不到几个钱，那个没啥学历的网红一个晚上就能赚到别人一辈子都赚不到的钱。
en: Why do highly educated people work hard for a month and earn little money, while that influencer with little education can earn in one night what others cannot earn in a lifetime?

text: 你不是看不起网红吗？
en: Didn't you look down on influencers?

text: 你不是说直播间都是骗人的吗？
en: Didn't you say livestream rooms are all scams?

text: 你不是说你自己从来不在直播间买东西吗？
en: Didn't you say you never buy things in livestreams?

text: 你不是说那都是公司操作的，根本不赚钱吗？
en: Didn't you say it was all company manipulation and doesn't make money at all?

text: 怎么，你这个自诩自己不看手机，不刷短视频也不看直播，逃脱了信息茧房的人，也有破防的那一天？
en: So, you who pride yourself on not looking at your phone, not scrolling short videos, not watching livestreams, having escaped the information cocoon — do you also have a day when your defences break?

text: 到底是刷短视频看直播的人进入了信息茧房，还是你这个不刷手机爱好看书的人进入了自己的信息茧房，自己还在那里沾沾自喜？
en: Is it the people who scroll short videos and watch livestreams who entered information cocoons, or is it you, the book-loving person who doesn't scroll your phone, who entered your own information cocoon, still feeling smug there?

text: 都不尽然。
en: Neither is entirely the case.

text: 事实是，每个人都有自己信息茧房。
en: The fact is, everyone has their own information cocoon.

text: 你之所以会看不起网红，无非就是看到自己靠刷题内卷出的一直学历文凭，还没有他们装疯卖傻、扭腰晃腚赚得多，有点气不过。
en: The reason you look down on influencers is simply that you see your academic credentials earned through grinding problems in involution are worth less than their acting crazy and stupid, twisting waists and shaking butts — which makes you a bit angry.

text: 要是谁高考考的分数高，谁大学学分绩高，谁获得奖多，就能赚的钱多，住的房子大就好了，那估计很多小镇做题家该觉得社会突然就公平了，世界突然就美好了。
en: If only whoever scored higher in the gaokao, whoever had a higher university GPA, whoever won more awards, could earn more money and live in a bigger house — then many small-town problem-solvers would probably feel society suddenly became fair, and the world suddenly became beautiful.

text: 不过可惜，社会不是那么运转的。
en: Unfortunately, society does not operate that way.

text: 你到售楼处问问人家，你的高数满分能抵多少首付，你看看人家搭不搭理你。
en: Go ask at a sales office: how much of a down payment can your perfect score in advanced mathematics offset? See whether they pay any attention to you.

text: 你整天看一些学术论文是你的信息获取方式，别人整天刷一些网络毒鸡汤也是别人的信息获取方式。
en: Your reading academic papers all day is your way of obtaining information; others scrolling toxic chicken soup all day is their way of obtaining information.

text: 别觉得自己是在做正事，被人都是被信息茧房困住了出不来。
en: Don't think you are doing serious business while others are all trapped in information cocoons and cannot get out.

text: 没那么多人需要你解救，没那么多人需要你瞧不起，你觉得举世皆醉我独醒的时候，也许你也在你自己的信息茧房里——只不过你觉得你在做正事，不愿承认罢了。
en: Not so many people need you to save them, not so many people need you to look down on them. When you feel that all are drunk but you alone are sober, perhaps you are also in your own information cocoon — only you feel you are doing serious business and are unwilling to admit it.

text: 人是社会的产物，更是信息的产物，没有人能够逃离。
en: People are products of society, and even more products of information; no one can escape.

text: 2、既然无法逃离，不如主动选择
en: 2. Since you cannot escape, you might as well actively choose.

text: 既然每个人都无法逃离信息茧房，那不如自己给自己选择一个好的信息茧房。
en: Since everyone cannot escape information cocoons, you might as well choose a good information cocoon for yourself.

text: 什么？
en: What?

text: 信息茧房还能选？
en: Information cocoons can be chosen?

text: 对的，你每天关注的那些博主，就是你的信息茧房的构成部分。
en: Yes — the bloggers you follow every day are components of your information cocoon.

text: 你关注拳师博主，整天看一些女拳言论，你估计看天底下所有男人都是潜在的家暴猥琐男，甚至连自己的老爸老公和儿子都看不顺眼，动不动总有刁民想害本宫；
en: If you follow boxer bloggers, watching feminist-boxer remarks all day, you will probably see all men in the world as potential domestic-violence creeps, and even find your own father, husband and son displeasing, always feeling unruly subjects are trying to harm me;

text: 你关注体育博主，整天看各种球星比赛，估计你一有空闲就想着往球场跑，甚至看到中国队输了，都会口吐芬芳：“rnm，退钱！
en: If you follow sports bloggers, watching various star matches all day, you will probably want to run to the court whenever you have free time, and even when you see the Chinese team lose, you will blurt out vulgarities: 'rnm, refund!

text: 你关注美食博主，整天看别人怎么做菜的，估计不用小半年，两个月你都能成为一个对美食一知半解的美食家，甚至自己做出来不错的菜品；
en: If you follow food bloggers, watching how others cook all day, you will probably become a half-knowledgeable foodie within less than half a year — two months — and even cook decent dishes yourself;

text: 你关注赚钱高知博主，比如 @温水公爵，整天看别人怎么分析社会讨论赚钱方法，提升思维水平，小半年你就能看懂社会的运行机制，知道赚钱的机会在哪里，砸碎学生思维，成为一个思路清晰行动力强的人了。
en: If you follow money-making knowledgeable bloggers, such as @Wen Shui Gong Jue, watching how others analyse society, discuss money-making methods, and improve thinking levels all day, within half a year you will understand society's operating mechanisms, know where money-making opportunities are, shatter student thinking, and become a person with clear ideas and strong execution.

text: 所以，如果无法逃脱，不如主动选择。
en: So, if you cannot escape, you might as well actively choose.

text: 当你发现自己根本不可能脱离信息茧房、游走于主流社会之外的时候，最明智的做法就是主动选择适合自己的信息茧房。
en: When you discover that you simply cannot detach from information cocoons and wander outside mainstream society, the wisest approach is to actively choose an information cocoon that suits you.

text: 什么是适合自己的信息茧房？
en: What is an information cocoon that suits you?

text: 简而言之，符合你自己的价值观。
en: In short, one that matches your own values.

text: 什么是价值观？
en: What are values?

text: 就是什么事情对于你来说更重要。
en: They are what matters more to you.

text: 你觉得爱情最重要，离了爱情你不能活，那你就整天看甜甜的剧，幻想某一天一个霸道总裁爱上你；
en: If you think love is most important, and you cannot live without love, then watch sweet dramas all day, fantasising that one day a domineering CEO will fall in love with you;

text: 你觉得女拳最重要，那你就整天关注各种拳师，看她们是怎么帮助姐妹甄别猥琐男的，和你一起骂男人，把生活中的不顺都骂出去；
en: If you think feminist boxing is most important, then follow various boxers all day, watch how they help sisters identify creeps, scold men together with you, and scold away life's frustrations;

text: 你觉得赚钱最重要，那你每天就关注各种优质的赚钱博主，比如 @温水公爵 提早认清社会的现实，辨析社会机理，抓住社会趋势，找准自己的位置，分得一杯羹。
en: If you think making money is most important, then follow various high-quality money-making bloggers every day, such as @Wen Shui Gong Jue, to recognise social reality early, analyse social mechanisms, grasp social trends, find your own position, and get a share.

text: 我经常做的事情就是，看看自己关注的哪些博主已经不在适合自己，又发现了哪些博主越来越适合自己，不断去完善自己的信息茧房。
en: What I often do is look at which bloggers I follow are no longer suitable for me, and which bloggers I have discovered are increasingly suitable for me, constantly improving my information cocoon.

text: 不要害怕自己会陷入信息茧房，你要做的不是拒绝，而是主动作为，主动选择，给自己搭建一个适合自己信息茧房。
en: Don't fear falling into information cocoons. What you should do is not refuse, but actively act, actively choose, and build an information cocoon that suits you.

text: 如果真的让我给一个人的信息茧房评价一下，我的评判标准就是：
en: If I were really asked to evaluate a person's information cocoon, my evaluation criterion would be:

text: 你的信息茧房是让你过的越来越好了，还是过的越来越差了，评判标准就用比较俗的吧——你的信息茧房是让你赚的钱越来越多了，还是让你赚钱越来越难，过得越来越差了？
en: Is your information cocoon making your life better and better, or worse and worse? Let's use a rather vulgar criterion — is your information cocoon making you earn more and more money, or making it harder and harder to earn money, and your life worse and worse?

text: 你比如我的信息茧房就是：及时发现社会发展趋势，什么赚钱，就想着尽快跟进，争取分一杯羹。
en: For example, my information cocoon is: promptly discovering social development trends, and whatever makes money, thinking about following up as soon as possible to get a share.

text: 我的信息茧房是以“赚钱”为中心，你的信息茧房呢？
en: My information cocoon centres on 'making money'. What about yours?
